introHtml: Wheat straw is a renewable byproduct of wheat harvesting, making it an eco-friendly alternative to traditional plastics. Custom wheat straw food and beverage products offer a sustainable choice for brands looking to reduce their environmental footprint. These items are lightweight, durable, and fully recyclable, ideal for trade shows, corporate gifts, or employee wellness programs. Choose from custom wheat straw water bottles, lunch containers, or travel mugs with your logo imprinted using screen printing or laser engraving.
